name: queens_n14__v7_h
prompt:
Place 14 queens on a 14×14 chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Queens attack along rows, columns, and diagonals.

Return a list of 14 integers where the i-th integer is the column position (0 to 13) of the queen in row i, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no solution exists.

Partial assignment (fixed values that must be respected):
- q[4]=4, q[6]=1
Return a complete solution consistent with these fixed assignments.
